data.title: Mackerel Tower
data.about:
Mackerel Tower by Saeed Tarrad Development introduces fully-furnished 1 and 2-bedroom apartments, and 4-bedroom penthouses, offering refined coastal living. This residential building by Saeed Tarrad Real Estate Development ensures luxurious interiors, breathtaking Gulf views, and thoughtfully designed layouts.

Located in the heart of Dubai Islands, Mackerel Tower boasts exceptional amenities, including swimming pools, a rooftop garden, and a yoga lounge. Residents enjoy seamless connectivity to key areas in Dubai and a flexible payment plan. With the expected handover scheduled for 2026, this waterfront residence on Dubai Islands is perfect for families and professionals alike.
Experience a lifestyle where elegance meets tranquility.

Mackerel Tower Floor Plan maximizes space and natural light, while premium finishes redefine modern comfort. Whether relaxing in the infinity pool or hosting a BBQ by the beach, Mackerel Tower amenities make every day extraordinary.

characteristics_module.title: Where Luxury Meets Tranquility – Your Dream Beachfront Residence Awaits.
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Prime waterfront residence on Dubai Islands offering luxurious living with breathtaking views of the Arabian Gulf.
  • Mackerel Tower by Saeed Tarrad Development features fully-furnished 1, 2-bedroom apartments and stunning 4-bedroom penthouses.
  • Exceptional Mackerel Tower amenities include an ool, fitness center, kids' play area, yoga lounge, and more.
  • Mackerel Tower location ensures easy access to major attractions like Dubai International Airport and Downtown Dubai.
  • Spacious Mackerel Tower Floor Plan maximizing natural light and panoramic views for every residence.
  • Flexible Mackerel Tower payment plan with 60/40 structure, making it easier to secure your dream home.

location_tile.title: Live at the Heart of Dubai Islands – Serene Beaches, Urban Convenience.
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Mackerel Tower at Dubai Islands is located in one of the most prestigious areas of Dubai, offering unmatched convenience and natural beauty. This waterfront residence on Dubai Islands by Saeed Tarrad Development provides a serene escape while strategically connecting to key parts of the city.

With easy access to major highways, Mackerel Tower ensures that residents can quickly reach iconic destinations like Downtown Dubai, Dubai International Airport, and Business Bay. The area blends the peacefulness of pristine beaches with the vibrancy of urban life, offering both tranquility and excitement.

Whether enjoying a day at the beach or exploring nearby shopping malls, dining options, and entertainment hubs, the Mackerel Tower location is ideal for those seeking the best of both worlds.

  • 10 Minutes to Gold Souq Metro Station
  • 14 Minutes to Dubai International Airport
  • 22 Minutes to Dubai World Trade Centre
  • 24 Minutes to Downtown Dubai
  • 26 Minutes to Business Bay
